claims.statement: Dot-product Q/K compatibility depends on vector lengths as well as direction; separately L2-normalizing nonzero Q/K gives cosine similarity and equal scores for equal angles.
claims.scope: The concrete nonzero 2D vectors and L2 normalization above epsilon; this is one local QK-normalization choice, not a claim that all attention models discard length.

claims.statement: Multiplying unequal scores by a larger positive scale concentrates softmax; an equivalent positive temperature is its reciprocal, and QK normalization may use a separately learned multiplier.
